column1: # 冻结：nvs 必须留在 0x9000-0x10000 头部之外。单文件整机镜像（idf.py merge-bin）按地址连续
# 覆盖 0x0 到 app 末尾，头部空洞一律填 0xFF；nvs 在头部就会被每次整刷抹掉（2026-10 前的历史行为）。
# Frozen: the nvs must stay out of the 0x9000-0x10000 head. A merged single-image (idf.py merge-bin)
# covers 0x0 through the app end contiguously and pads every head gap with 0xFF; a head-placed nvs
# was wiped by every full-image flash before 2026-10.
# 冻结：storage 缩 32 KB 而不是 16 KB。wear leveling 把状态区放在分区末尾（约 52 KB），收缩量
# 必须越过旧状态尾区，旧卷才会 CRC 失败并干净重格式化；缩 16 KB 会带着旧几何静默挂载、损坏
# /flash 书库（见 IDF components/wear_levelling/WL_Flash.cpp 的 init 状态读取）。
# Frozen: storage shrinks 32 KB
column2: not 16 KB. Wear levelling keeps its state at the partition tail
